entries.en: Got anything I can sink my teeth in?
entries.ro: Ai ceva de care să-mi înfig dinții?

entries.en: You look exhausted. That's not off-putting to the customers?

entries.en: What've you got that I can sink my teeth in?

entries.en: Hmph... You're the thirtieth person who's told me that today.
entries.ro: Hmph... Ești a treizecea persoană care-mi zice asta azi.

entries.en: Anything you like – just say the word.
entries.ro: Orice îți place – spune doar cuvântul.
